mapper.sql: l.id, l.laoren_bianhao as laorenBianhao, l.xingming, l.xingbie, l.nianling, l.laoren_leixing as laorenLeixing, l.ruzhu_zhuangtai as ruzhuZhuangtai, l.lianxi_dianhua as lianxiDianhua, l.jiating_zhuzhi as jiatingZhuzhi, l.touxiang
mapper.select: select from laoren_xinxi l where l.ruzhu_zhuangtai != '已删除' order by l.id desc

select distinct from laoren_xinxi l join renyuan_laoren rl on l.id = rl.laoren_id join huli_renyuan hr on rl.huli_renyuan_id = hr.id where hr.yonghu_id = #{yonghuId} and l.ruzhu_zhuangtai != '已删除' order by l.id desc
select distinct from laoren_xinxi l join jiashu_xinxi j on l.id = j.laoren_id join xitong_yonghu y on j.shouji = y.shouji where y.id = #{yonghuId} and l.ruzhu_zhuangtai != '已删除' order by l.id desc
select l.id, l.laoren_bianhao as laorenBianhao, l.xingming, l.xingbie, l.nianling, l.ruzhu_zhuangtai as ruzhuZhuangtai from laoren_xinxi l where l.ruzhu_zhuangtai != '已删除' order by l.id desc
select id, xingming, ruzhu_zhuangtai as ruzhuZhuangtai from laoren_xinxi where id = #{id} and ruzhu_zhuangtai != '已删除'
mapper.update: update laoren_xinxi set laoren_bianhao = #{laorenBianhao}, xingming = #{xingming}, xingbie = #{xingbie}, chusheng_riqi = #{chushengRiqi}, nianling = #{nianling}, shenfenzheng = #{shenfenzheng}, xuexing = #{xuexing}, hunyin_zhuangkuang = #{hunyinZhuangkuang}, laoren_leixing = #{laorenLeixing}, ruzhu_zhuangtai = #{ruzhuZhuangtai}, lianxi_dianhua = #{lianxiDianhua}, jiating_zhuzhi = #{jiatingZhuzhi}, touxiang = #{touxiang}, beizhu = #{beizhu} where id = #{id}
update laoren_xinxi set ruzhu_zhuangtai = '已删除' where id = #{id}
update laoren_xinxi set ruzhu_zhuangtai = #{zhuangtai} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) from ruzhu_shenqing where id = #{shenqingId} and laoren_id = #{laorenId} and shenqing_zhuangtai = '已通过' and coalesce(banli_zhuangtai, '未办理') = '未办理' and shanchu_zhuangtai = '正常'
